title: 第十一章 、卖情报盒子，苟王之路正式开始
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【名字：情报盒子】

【类别：道具】

【等级：传说】

【效果一：惊喜任务栏——完成上面发布的任务，会有意想不到的收获（非酋就别来试，一试一个不吭声，黄泉路上你来伴）。】

【效果二：苟得久，王中王——每活过一天，都会随机更新一个标签，标签属性随机。】

【效果三：秘密花园没有秘密哦！——这里是全知的海洋，只要付出一点点代价，你想知道什么，都能在里面找到。】

又是一件道具，端木棠梨悄咪咪将其收入囊中，对着上面赵老爷子一直没有击落下来的蓝色水滴七号图案积木虎视眈眈。

这东西一定也是好东西，想个办法将其给弄下来？

端木棠梨想要利用情报盒子第三个秘密花园，分析抽取积木的安全方法，点开秘密花园。

【是否要消耗一百生存值兑换秘密花朵？】

端木棠梨沉默了，她忘记自己大穷鬼的身份，还是看看其他能力，是否对目前情况有所帮助？

点击任务栏，上面有两个任务出现。

【任务一：在里世界幽灵列车活下来，奖励生存值十点，一朵秘密花朵，里世界盲盒坐标三份。】

【任务二：从积木叠叠高游戏里活下来，奖励生存值一点，里世界盲盒坐标一份。】

【任务三：活到第二天凌晨五点，奖励生存值一百点，三朵秘密花朵，里世界盲盒坐标五份。】

端木棠梨看到自己一个任务里面，眼睛猛然睁大，心脏狂跳不已。

任务肯定是越难，奖励越丰富。

任务三的奖励内容告诉端木棠梨，一旦推迟到明天凌晨五点钟，危险极大，搞不好要葬身于此，能提早跑路就跑。

端木棠梨收到宝贝的好心情，被这条突如其来的爆炸消息给弄得烟消云散。

情报盒子第二项功能，要端木棠梨活过第二天才能用，根本靠不上，还是多在这个副本搜集一些道具伴身。

端木棠梨忽略了任务奖励所说的盲盒，作为平民家乖乖小孩，这些非生活所需东西，她都很少接触过。

奢侈品店事情，还是自家好闺蜜说，一时之间没有反应过来。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Name: Information Box]

[Category: Props]

[Level: Legend]

[Effect 1: Surprise task bar - complete the tasks posted above, and you will have unexpected gains (don't try it if you are not a chieftain, try it without saying a word, you will accompany me on the road to hell).】

[Effect 2: Gou Dejiu, the King of Kings—Every day he lives, a label will be randomly updated with random label attributes.】

[Effect 3: There are no secrets in the secret garden!——This is the ocean of omniscience. As long as you pay a small price, you can find whatever you want to know in it.】

It was another prop. Duanmu Tangli quietly pocketed it and stared at the blue water drop No. 7 pattern building block that Mr. Zhao had never knocked down.

This thing must be a good thing. Think of a way to get it off?

Duanmu Tangli wanted to use the third secret garden of the intelligence box, analyze the safe method of extracting the building blocks, and click on the secret garden.

[Should I spend 100 survival points to exchange for secret flowers?】

Duanmu Tangli was silent. She had forgotten her identity as a poor man, or should she look at other abilities to see if they could help the current situation?

Click on the taskbar, and two tasks will appear on it.

[Task 1: Survive the ghost train in the other world, and you will be rewarded with ten survival points, a secret flower, and three copies of the coordinates of the blind box in the other world.】

[Task 2: Survive the Jenga game and be rewarded with one survival point and the coordinates of a blind box in the world.】

[Task 3: Survive until five o'clock in the morning the next day, and you will be rewarded with 100 survival points, three secret flowers, and five blind box coordinates in the inner world.】

When Duanmu Tangli saw one of his missions, his eyes suddenly opened wide and his heart beat wildly.

The more difficult the task, the richer the reward.

The reward content of task three tells Duanmu Tangli that once it is postponed to five o'clock tomorrow morning, it will be extremely dangerous, and he may be buried here, so he can run away early.

Duanmu Tangli's good mood after receiving the baby was completely shattered by this sudden explosive news.

The second function of the intelligence box requires Duanmu Tangli to survive the next day before it can be used. It is not reliable at all. It is better to collect some props in this dungeon to accompany you.

Duanmu Tangli ignored the blind box mentioned in the mission reward. As an obedient child from a civilian family, she rarely came into contact with these things that were not necessary for daily life.

My best friend told me about the luxury store, but I didn’t react for a while.

title_en: Chapter 11: Selling information boxes, the road to King Gou officially begins
